function.arguments: {"finding": "The raw conversion rate in the email channel (38.04%) is higher than in paid_search (31.06%), but this is likely due to selection bias: the email campaign targeted loyal and returning customers, who naturally have higher conversion rates regardless of the campaign. The paid_search channel reached more new customers, who convert less. A raw comparison would falsely suggest the campaign was successful — but it's confounded.", "implication": "We must adjust for customer segment to estimate the true causal effect. We used stratified analysis, computing the difference in conversion rates within each segment, and weighting by the proportion of each segment in the email group. This gives a more valid estimate of the campaign's effect."}
function.name: note_finding
